note: A fixture corpus for the harness tests. The real corpus is at conformance-primitives/_shared/cases/v1/cases.json; the tests use these values to exercise the loader, the selectors and the fold, and no value here is a conformance fact.

cases.label: canonical value
cases.rationale: a fixture row, so the loader and the selectors have a success case to carry.

cases.label: padded spelling
cases.rationale: a fixture row, so the fold has a defined refusal to carry.

cases.label: recorded ciphertext
cases.rationale: a fixture row under a second operation, so a run can select on an operation and a set separately.

cases.label: ciphertext that does not open
cases.rationale: a fixture row, so a second operation's defined refusal is carried too.

cases.label: known answer
cases.rationale: a fixture row in a second set, so a --set selection has something to leave out.

cases.label: carrier under other additional data
cases.rationale: a fixture row, so the second set carries a refusal beside its value.
